one_line: Early imperial Pallava ruler who pushed Kanchipuram’s power south toward the Kaveri frontier.

appearance.age_look: late thirties, medium-tall, athletic but not bulky, poised royal bearing
appearance.face: oval face with high cheekbones, medium brown South Indian complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed mustache and short beard along jawline, calm intense eyes with a slight upward tilt, default expression composed and thoughtful with a subtle confident half-smile
appearance.hair: thick black hair pulled back into a high, smooth topknot at the crown, the length wrapped and secured with a simple gold band; front hairline clean with no loose fringe; wears a modest cylindrical golden diadem circlet resting just above the topknot, engraved with small leaf motifs
appearance.costume: He wears a finely draped off-white cotton vesti (dhoti) in the South Indian style, wrapped from the waist down to the ankles with a neat, slightly flared hem, featuring a broad deep maroon border edged in gold; over his torso he has a fitted short-sleeved pale cream cotton tunic that reaches mid-hip, its neckline modest and round with a narrow gold trim; across his left shoulder and chest is a rich handloom silk uttariya (upper cloth) in dark teal, worn like a sash and flowing diagonally across the back, with subtle repeating geometric patterns in maroon and gold thread; his arms carry two plain gold armlets above the biceps and slim gold bangles at the wrists, and he wears a simple multi-strand pearl-and-gold necklace resting on his chest; his ears bear small, round gold stud earrings; on his feet are brown leather sandals with simple straps, historically plausible for a royal moving between court and campaign; overall the garments are clean, orderly and modest, with no exposed torso and a clear Pallava-era South Indian royal aesthetic.
appearance.signature: A long, slightly curved South Indian iron sword with a simple cross-guard, plain rounded wooden hilt and a polished steel blade, sheathed in a dark brown leather scabbard with minimal bronze fittings, worn at his left hip and held lightly in his right hand when posed.

ref_desc: Simhavishnu Pallava is a late-thirties South Indian ruler with an oval medium-brown face, black topknot and gold circlet, wearing an off-white dhoti, cream tunic, dark teal sash with maroon-gold borders, simple gold jewellery and brown sandals, carrying a curved sword in a brown scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Simhavishnu Pallava: a late-thirties South Indian king with an oval medium-brown face, calm intense eyes, neat mustache and short jawline beard, and thick black hair in a high topknot bound by a simple gold band, topped with a modest cylindrical gold circlet engraved with leaf motifs. Show him in an off-white South Indian dhoti wrapped to the ankles with a broad deep maroon border edged in gold, a pale cream short-sleeved tunic covering his torso to mid-hip with narrow gold trim at the round neckline, and a dark teal silk upper cloth worn as a diagonal sash from left shoulder across the chest and back, carrying subtle maroon and gold geometric patterns. Include plain gold armlets, slim gold bangles, a small multi-strand pearl-and-gold necklace, and small round gold stud earrings, with brown leather sandals on his feet. At his left hip show a long slightly curved South Indian sword in a dark brown leather scabbard with minimal bronze fittings; in the frontal pose his right hand lightly rests on or holds the hilt. Use off-white, deep maroon, dark teal, gold and brown as the dominant colours, and present him from multiple angles to emphasize consistent face, topknot with circlet, dhoti, tunic, sash, jewellery and sword placement in a dignified, era-accurate royal style.
